projects.name: River Bend campus
projects.quote: Signed a 15-year, $7.0 billion lease with Fluidstack for 245 MW of IT capacity at River Bend, with the lease payments and related pass-through - obligations for the base term financially backstopped by Google.

projects.name: River Bend expansion phases
projects.quote: The agreement grants Fluidstack a Right of First Offer for up to an additional 1,000 MW of IT capacity at future expansion phases at River Bend, subject to the expansion of power at the site.

projects.name: Anthropic and Fluidstack AI infrastructure partnership
projects.quote: Launched a partnership with Anthropic and Fluidstack to accelerate the - deployment of hyperscale AI infrastructure in the United States, under which Hut 8 will develop and deliver at least 245 MW and up to 2,295 MW of AI data center infrastructure.

projects.name: Four new United States sites
projects.quote: Announced plans to develop four new sites with more than 1,500 MW of total capacity across the United States, including 330 MW of utility - capacity at the Company’s River Bend campus in Louisiana.

projects.name: Vega
projects.quote: Energized Vega, a 205 MW data center that commercializes a next-generation Tier 1 form factor for ASIC compute, featuring a - proprietary, rack-based, direct-to-chip liquid cooling system designed by Hut 8 to support ASIC deployments at densities of up to 180 kilowatts (“kW”) per rack.
